sources.title: 卡倫堡工業共生官方介紹
sources.scope: 支援跨企業水、能源與物料交換的組織模式；不把動態成員數或減碳值寫成固定工程參數。
sources.scopeEn: Supports inter-company water, energy and material exchange; changing member counts or carbon savings are not treated as fixed engineering parameters.

sources.title: 卡倫堡共生：合作與歷史
sources.scope: 支援實體交換網路與信任、合作的作用；步驟中的合約與異常案例為原創教學情境。
sources.scopeEn: Supports physical exchange networks and the role of trust and cooperation; contract and incident cases are original teaching scenarios.

sources.title: 工業共生促進指南：卡倫堡案例
sources.titleEn: Guide for Industrial Symbiosis Facilitators: Kalundborg case
sources.scope: 支援 1961 年供水連接、1996 年秘書處成立與合作治理背景；不提供現行管網操作許可。
sources.scopeEn: Supports the 1961 water connection, 1996 secretariat and collaborative governance; not authorization to operate current networks.

courses.overview: 從「卡倫堡工業共生系統」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 把「卡倫堡工業共生系統」與「新加坡新生水系統」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis with Singapore NEWater System: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.mapQuery: Former NEWater Visitor Centre, 20 Koh Sek Lim Road, Singapore 486593
place.name: 舊勿洛新生水廠與訪客中心（已關閉）
place.nameEn: Former Bedok NEWater factory and visitor centre (closed)
place.address: Former NEWater Visitor Centre, 20 Koh Sek Lim Road, Singapore 486593
place.addressEn: Former NEWater Visitor Centre, 20 Koh Sek Lim Road, Singapore 486593
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 工業用水與資源交換需要確認供需量、品質、管線介面和中斷後的替代方案。
related.transferEn: Industrial water and resource exchange require quantity, quality, pipeline-interface and interruption planning.
related.difference: NEWater 是水處理與供應體系；卡倫堡交換多種物料和能源，不能以單一水質指標管理所有流。
related.differenceEn: NEWater treats and supplies water; Kalundborg exchanges multiple materials and energy streams, so one water-quality metric cannot govern every flow.
practice: 為每條交換流標示用途和品質
區分回收水、蒸汽與副產物
提出一方停機時的替代情境
practiceEn: Label purpose and quality for each exchange stream
Distinguish reclaimed water, steam and by-products
Describe a contingency when one partner stops

related.title: 呂勒奧HYBRIT試驗工程
related.why: 把「卡倫堡工業共生系統」與「呂勒奧HYBRIT試驗工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis with Lulea HYBRIT Pilot Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: 呂勒奧 HYBRIT 試驗工程（城市代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 工業減碳需要以系統邊界追蹤能源、物料和副產物流，避免只看單一設備效率。
related.transferEn: Industrial decarbonization tracks energy, material and by-product flows across defined boundaries rather than one device’s efficiency.
related.difference: HYBRIT 改變還原鐵的製程路徑；卡倫堡將多家工廠的資源互相串接，兩者的減碳機制不同。
related.differenceEn: HYBRIT changes the iron-reduction route; Kalundborg connects resource flows across companies, using different decarbonization mechanisms.
practice: 畫出廠內製程與跨廠交換邊界
列出直接與間接能源需求
對缺乏資料的排放量保留未知
practiceEn: List direct and indirect energy demands

courses.summary: 卡倫堡共生是跨企業與公共部門逐步形成的交換網路，不是單一工廠。地圖標示城市與產業群的概略位置，不表示管線路徑、企業入口或目前所有成員。
courses.summaryEn: Kalundborg Symbiosis is a gradually developed exchange network involving firms and public bodies, not one factory. The marker approximates the city and industrial cluster, not pipeline routes, company entrances or all current members.

history.title: 地表水供應連接形成
history.text: 官方促進指南記述，從 Tissø 湖向煉油設施供水的連接，成為後來共生網路的早期背景。
history.textEn: The official facilitator guide describes a Lake Tissø water connection to the refinery as an early antecedent of the later symbiosis network.

history.title: 共生秘書處成立
history.text: 秘書處的成立使交流與協調有了持續的組織支援，顯示治理也是工程系統的一部分。
history.textEn: Establishing the secretariat provided continuing organizational support for exchange and coordination, showing that governance is part of the engineering system.

courses.connection: 地圖提供合作發生的地理背景；課程以匿名教學網路練習資源適配、計量邊界與共同證據。
courses.connectionEn: The map supplies the geographic context of cooperation; an anonymous teaching network supports practice in resource fit, metering boundaries and shared evidence.
